title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037300417 by contracting the role-1256 relay on the cf6a word
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The new banked construction gives **κ ≥ 0.0037300417** under the five assumptions of the selected #7000 application. This lower bound exceeds **#7700’s supplied-word invoice upper by 0.00000069852193** and **#7697’s fully priced banked upper by 0.0000034128230**. Please review the exact graph, its physical implementation and its signed caller for conditional frontier admission. [Proof, receipts and replay](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay)

On helper 1256, the 476→878 return at key 95828 has one reader, the coefficient-one sender at 104442 from 878→127. The construction replaces the pair with the directly phased map 476→127 at the retained key. All four original donors are available at the new position. Every later public return agrees on arbitrary independent inputs. Every chronological source CLEAR relation and the actual banked retirement have a separate check.

| Complete 16-stage signed caller | Folded #7700 parent | Role-1256 relay |
|---|---:|---:|
| Paid placements, including 3,552 fixed caller payments | 101,856 | 101,840 |
| Productive targets | 21,152 | 21,152 |
| Charged numerical homes per stage, plus four streams | 9,151 | 9,150 |
| Directed raw crossing | (0.00372934317806, 0.00372934317807) | (0.0037300417703, 0.0037300417704) |

## Task and overlap

This refines `p104-side-correction` to one change to the paid profile. The base is canonical `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. SYLforge’s #7700 head `7d84799a447867d36137d12ef7ca5646154d763c` supplies the immutable word `ae62d5d8bef6f7146454b4b3643e487a58380c606a16c5baef7bf0dcf9df1472`. It establishes a finite word and invoice. This package constructs and charges a banked implementation from those bytes. The folded parent is `72705b094d83d2ba24006661bbb031786a691b776bedb94515b1321e1535105f`, the child is `8e7b755bd2d2d387bc3d3adfe48100985adf74775ca5acbb143170a3d16b5ccf`, and the literal signed caller is `62d94fb992acab0a71c3d12f22be4ce63f4f65e5cbe3f420b93aa1393ffa8dcf`. #7697 at `f55fc1434436ffa1c6d064a29fc56812044b3157` supplies the separate charged comparator. The chart-595 arithmetic audits #7701 and #7702 concern its different graph. [Scoped findings and alternative handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19708867)

The scientific change is one commit in `research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/`. Its prerequisite `0eabc624a9bc9ed2847719efd63390db4d297df4` carries the five files from the historical CI repair used by #7697 so canonical CI can reach the scientific replay. [CI prerequisite #7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257)

## Verification

From the repository root with CPython 3.12 and its standard library, run

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay
```

A clean checkout of `e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93` passed all three registered groups in 308.67 seconds. The exact check covers the forward and adjoint operators, 1,501 public owners, all 235 source CLEARs, ordered recipes and the common grid. It replays all 512 columns of the direct map in each direction and the full signed caller with 3,536 independent root targets and 17,616 stage helpers. Four held-array cases over two primes match their direct oracle. A one-quarter phase error corrupts exactly 18 public outputs, including four mains. Omitting one copy charge, using a stale compiler bound or adding one rank-one payment defeats the associated controls.

The finite compiler used H = 14,571,800,000,000,000,000 and passed its 14,083-bit guard, 54 strict inequalities and four functional checks. Independent directed arithmetic brackets the raw crossing in (0.00373004177032, 0.00373004177033). The package itemizes ordinary scalar, complete-extent allocation, layout, transfer and retirement costs. [Independent operator and price review](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/tree/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/review) · [Signed bill](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93/research/cf6a-banked-role1256-relay/evidence/PRICE.json)

## Credit and remaining obligations

SYLforge supplied the exact word. DreamingOfClouds, Ali Romman, Rohan Arun, CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt and the contributors credited in #7658, #7663, #7669, #7674, #7682, #7697 and the selected application supplied predecessor constructions, services and refereeing evidence. Clear1nsight prepared this contribution with substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. Source notices and exact input provenance are included.

The five inherited assumptions concern native realization on all columns, owned erasure, compiler closure, fixed-tape precision and movement, and analytic recovery. The supplied search generator lies outside the derivation. A materialized all-size multiplier, a proof-kernel result and human maintainer review remain open.

## Open next questions

For admission, independently replay the changed native recipe, check the private-bank retirement and caller substitution against #7000, and verify the directed separation on this head. The investigation handoff also identifies a distinct pivot on the parent graph whose combined physical and signed price remains open.
